content.value: The following consecutive readings were taken with a level and a 4-meter (20) leveling staff on a continuously sloping ground at common intervals of 30 m: 0.855m(on A), 1.545 m, 2.335 m, 3.115 m, 3.825 m, 0.0455 m, 1.380m, 2.055 m, 3.455 m, 0.585m, 1.015 m, 1.850 m, 2.755 m and 3.845m (on B). The RL of A was 380.500. Make entries in a level book and apply the usual checks. Determine the slope of AB. The change points were taken at 120 m and 240 m in chainage.
